Hi @Shreedhar Anand

Thank you for the detailed questionnaire, and for your patience while I pull the answers together on our end.

I can confirm the deployment piece today. We run a standard change freeze from November 12 through December 9 for the Black Friday period, and a second one from December 10 through mid January for the holiday season. No customer specific deployments are planned during those windows.

The certificate status, the stress testing and auto scaling question, and the current contact and escalation list are being pulled together with the teams that own that information.

I will come back to you as soon as I hear back on those, and I will not leave you waiting on this.

I have everything I need from you for now. Please let me know if anything changes on your end before then.

Best regards,
Juan

Hi @Shreedhar Anand ,

Thank you for your patience on this one. I have updates on three of the four items from your questionnaire.

For certificates, Walgreens is currently part of a migration project that will remove the need for the certificate that requires manual renewal today. Since that project is being coordinated on your side, connecting with Shashank will give you the most current status and timeline. As part of that same project, your environment will also move to one that supports auto scaling, so that covers the auto scaling piece as well.

For the contact and escalation question, all support requests, at any priority level, go through our Support Portal, and that channel is available around the clock, with response times set by priority. Beyond a ticket itself, we maintain a three level escalation path on our side, starting with our Customer Support Manager, then our Customer Success Manager, then our VP of Customer Support.

The stress testing question is still being confirmed with the team that owns it. I will come back to you as soon as I hear back, and I will not leave you waiting on this.

I have everything I need from you for now. Please let me know if anything changes on your end before then.

Best regards,
Juan

Responded to the client email:

[RCS-28871] -Walgreens - Peak Season Readiness 2026 : 3rd party connect (Appriss Retail)

Hello Mohit,

Thank you for following up.

Please note that this request is being actively tracked under RCS-28871, with @shreedhar.anand@walgreens.com as the reporter. Shreedhar will also receive the updates through the RCS ticket.

The latest update was provided by Juan on September 16 and we would like to share the details with you below:

For certificates, Walgreens is currently part of a migration project that will remove the need for the certificate that requires manual renewal today. Since that project is being coordinated on your side, connecting with Shashank will give you the most current status and timeline. As part of that same project, your environment will also move to one that supports auto scaling, so that covers the auto scaling piece as well.

For the contact and escalation question, all support requests, at any priority level, go through our Support Portal, and that channel is available around the clock, with response times set by priority. Beyond a ticket itself, we maintain a three level escalation path on our side, starting with our Customer Support Manager, then our Customer Success Manager, then our VP of Customer Support.

The stress testing question is still being confirmed with the team that owns it. Juan will provide an update once he receives confirmation from the respective team.

We will continue tracking this request under RCS-28871 and provide further updates as they become available.

For all future updates and communication regarding this ticket, please log in to the Appriss Retail Support Portal: https://support.apprissretailcloud.com
